findings.passage: Today, Legislative Republicans have shown that their number one priority is passing a constitutional amendment that could disenfranchise voters because their austerity agenda is unpopular. There’s a historic legacy of voter suppression in Wisconsin’s Black communities – this is yet another attempt to silence the voices of Black, Brown and Indigenous people in Wisconsin.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name when the Assembly passed AJR 1, the voter ID constitutional amendment. He says the amendment could keep people from voting and ties it to past voter suppression. Date is from the official press release list (legis.wisconsin.gov/assembly/10/madison/news-updates/press-releases/).
